滿十進一: Regroup ten as one in the next place
暫時無法播放女聲，請再點一次朗讀，或閱讀畫面上的文字提示。: Speech is unavailable. Try Read Aloud again, or follow the text on screen.
10 個一千元合起來是多少元？: How much are ten NT$1,000 bills worth altogether?
「五千零六十」用阿拉伯數字要怎麼記錄？: How do you write ‘five thousand and sixty’ in digits?
一千一千地倒著數：9000 ➔ 8000 ➔ 7000 ➔ （ ） ➔ 5000: Count back in thousands: 9000 → 8000 → 7000 → ( ) → 5000. What number is missing?
「3259」是由幾個千、幾個百、幾個十和幾個一合起來的？: How many thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones make 3259?
露營帳篷賣 4512 元，其中百位數字是哪一個？表示多少？: A tent costs NT$4,512. Which digit is in the hundreds place, and what is its value?
【雙條件位值比較】下列哪一個四位數，千位數字比百位數字「小」，十位數字比個位數字: Which four-digit number has a thousands digit smaller than its hundreds digit AND a tens digit greater than its ones digit?
小語想買一臺 2295 元的腳踏車，可是她只有 1000 元，還要存幾元才夠買？: Xiaoyu wants a bicycle costing NT$2,295. She has NT$1,000. How much more does she need?
數線上一小格代表 100，跳棋停在 900 的位置，往左移 4 格，會停在哪一個: Each interval on the number line is 100. A counter starts at 900 and moves 4 intervals left. Where does it stop?
數線上每小格是 1，算式「4859 ＋ 4」在數線上是從 4859 往右移幾格？: Each interval on the number line is 1. To find 4859 + 4, how many intervals do you move right from 4859, and where do you stop?
果園裡橘子採收了 2253 個，柳丁採收了 1850 個，一共採收了多少個水果？: An orchard harvests 2,253 oranges and 1,850 tangerines. How many pieces of fruit are there altogether?
哥哥想買一臺熱門遊戲機，已經存了 3985 元，還差 768 元才夠，買這臺遊戲: Your brother has saved NT$3,985 for a game console. He needs NT$768 more. How much does the console cost?
佳彤有 500 元，報名 319 元的「夜釣小管」活動後，還剩下幾元？: Jiatong has NT$500. She pays NT$319 for a night squid-fishing activity. How much money is left?
小明買拼圖花了 622 元，還剩下 2378 元，小明原有幾元？: Ming spends NT$622 on a puzzle and has NT$2,378 left. How much money did he have at first?
大明撲滿裡有 2500 元，買故事書花了 650 元，爸爸又獎勵他 200 元，: Ming has NT$2,500 in his savings bank. He spends NT$650 on storybooks, then his father gives him NT$200. How much money does he have now?
澎湖自由行船票 A 方案 3199 元，B 方案 5899 元，大約相差幾千元？: Ferry plan A costs NT$3,199 and plan B costs NT$5,899. About how many thousands of dollars is the difference?
一瓶果汁 75 元，特價買 5 瓶，一共需要多少元？: A bottle of juice costs NT$75. How much do 5 bottles cost?
一件運動外套 213 元，買 3 件一共要付多少元？（不進位）: A sports jacket costs NT$213. How much do 3 jackets cost? (No regrouping.)
妮妮想買 3 本 198 元的故事書，她帶 600 元，夠付嗎？: Nini wants three storybooks costing NT$198 each. Is NT$600 enough?
算式「403 × 5」大約是多少？估算結果比實際算出來的答案多還是少？: Estimate 403 × 5. Is your estimate greater or less than the exact answer?
比大小：4 公分 8 毫米 和 50 毫米，哪一個比較長？: Which is longer: 4 cm 8 mm or 50 mm?
奇奇有兩枝粉筆，長粉筆 6 公分 8 毫米，短粉筆 4 公分 3 毫米，相差多少: One piece of chalk is 6 cm 8 mm long and another is 4 cm 3 mm long. What is the difference? (No regrouping.)
算式「5 公分 6 毫米 ＋ 3 公分 7 毫米」的毫米部分相加是 13 毫米，: To add 5 cm 6 mm + 3 cm 7 mm, first add the millimeters: 6 + 7 = 13 mm. What can you trade 10 mm for?
一根竹筷長 18 公分 4 毫米，折斷用掉 6 公分 8 毫米，還剩下多少？: A chopstick is 18 cm 4 mm long. A piece 6 cm 8 mm long breaks off. How long is the remaining piece?
判斷：如果一個圖形的兩條邊是彎彎曲曲的線，它是不是數學上說的「角」？: If a shape has two curved lines, do they form an angle in mathematics?
拿兩支活動角玩具，藍色角張開比較大，紅色角張開比較小，哪一個角比較大？: Two hinged angle models are open. The blue model opens wider than the red model. Which angle is larger?
拿出數學附件的三角板，三角板上有一個方方正正的角，這個角叫作什麼角？: Look at a set square. What do we call its square corner?
比直角「小」的角，尖尖細細的，叫作什麼角？: What do we call an angle smaller than a right angle?
比直角「大」的角，開得寬寬胖胖的，叫作什麼角？: What do we call an angle larger than a right angle but smaller than a straight angle?
拿一張正方形色紙，先左右對摺，再上下對摺後打開，摺痕交叉形成的角是什麼角？: Fold a square sheet in half from left to right, then top to bottom. Unfold it. What angles do the crossing folds make?
一塊常見的三角板，它上面的三個角分別是什麼角？: What types of angles does a standard set square have?
下面哪一個角度的敘述是錯誤的？: Which statement about angles is incorrect?
正方形的 4 條邊長度有什麼關係？: What is true about the lengths of the four sides of a square?
寫直式除法「29 ÷ 7」時，商要寫在定位板的哪一位上方？: When setting out the long division 29 ÷ 7, above which place should you write the quotient?
算式「38 ÷ 4」的直式計算，商是多少？餘數是多少？: Use long division to calculate 38 ÷ 4. What are the quotient and remainder?
測量比較少量液體（如眼藥水、感冒藥水）的「毫升」，英文縮寫符號是什麼？: Which abbreviation means milliliter, a small unit for measuring liquids such as eye drops?
比大小：3 公升 20 毫升 和 3200 毫升，哪一個容量比較大？: Which is greater: 3 L 20 mL or 3,200 mL?
紅果汁有 1 公升 200 毫升，黃果汁有 2 公升 300 毫升，兩瓶共有多少: There is 1 L 200 mL of red juice and 2 L 300 mL of yellow juice. How much juice is there altogether? (No regrouping.)
水壺裡原本有 1 公升 800 毫升的水，喝掉 500 毫升後，還剩下多少？（不: A jug contains 1 L 800 mL of water. After drinking 500 mL, how much is left? (No regrouping.)
計算「1 公升 700 毫升 ＋ 2 公升 500 毫升」，毫升相加是 1200: Add 1 L 700 mL + 2 L 500 mL. The milliliters total 1,200 mL. What can you trade 1,000 mL for?
水桶裡原本有 5 公升的水，洗車用掉 3 公升 450 毫升，還剩下多少水？: A bucket contains 5 L of water. You use 3 L 450 mL to wash a car. How much water is left?
媽媽煮綠豆湯，加了 2 公升 350 毫升的水，煮好後水分蒸發了 450 毫升，: A pot starts with 2 L 350 mL of water. During cooking, 450 mL evaporates. How much water is left?
奇奇每天喝 1 公升 500 毫升的水，妮妮每天喝 1800 毫升的水，兩人一天: Qiqi drinks 1 L 500 mL of water a day. Nini drinks 1,800 mL. How much do they drink altogether?
把 1 塊布朗尼蛋糕「平分」成 4 塊，其中的 1 塊是幾分之幾塊蛋糕？: A brownie is cut into 4 equal pieces. What fraction of the whole brownie is one piece?
1 個大披薩平分成 6 塊，萱萱吃了 2 塊，是吃了幾個披薩？: A pizza is cut into 6 equal slices. Xuanxuan eats 2 slices. What fraction of the pizza does she eat?
把 1 條緞帶平分成 10 段，其中的 7 段是幾條緞帶？: A ribbon is cut into 10 equal pieces. What fraction of the whole ribbon is 7 pieces?
1 個完整的圓形蛋糕，可以看成幾分之幾？（平分成 4 份時）: A whole cake is divided into 4 equal pieces. How many quarter-pieces make the whole cake?
8 個「1/8」合起來是 8/8，8/8 等於整數多少？: Eight eighths make 8/8. What whole number equals 8/8?
兩盒蛋黃酥的數量與每顆大小都相同。奇奇吃了 3/6 盒，妙妙吃了 2/6 盒，誰: Two boxes have the same number of equally sized pastries. Qiqi eats 3/6 of a box and Miaomiao eats 2/6 of a box. Who eats more, and by what fraction of a box?
一瓶汽水平分成 10 杯，宸宸喝了 4 杯，涵涵喝了 5 杯，還剩下幾分之幾瓶汽: A bottle of soda fills 10 equal cups. Chenchen drinks 4 cups and Hanhan drinks 5 cups. What fraction of the bottle is left?
從「圓心」連到「圓周」上的任何一條直線，叫作什麼？: What do we call a line segment from the center to the edge of a circle?
通過「圓心」，而且兩端都在「圓周」上的直線，叫作什麼？: What do we call a line segment that passes through the center of a circle and has both ends on the circle?
如果一條直線的兩端都在圓周上，但是「沒有通過圓心」，這條線是直徑嗎？: A line segment has both ends on a circle but does not pass through its center. Is it a diameter?
小明用圓規畫圓，兩腳張開 5 公分，畫出來的圓「直徑」是多少公分？: Ming opens a pair of compasses to 5 cm and draws a circle. What is its diameter?
「換一題」會更換題目；「這題重來」保留本題。: New Question gives you a different task. Restart keeps this task.
3000 再多 1 個，是個位多 1。百位和十位仍然是 0，寫作 3001！: Adding 1 to 3000 changes the ones digit from 0 to 1. The hundreds and tens stay 0. The number is 3001!
